query: SELECT the_highest_ownership_stake, revenue, board_members FROM Finance WHERE revenue <= 12857200000 OR total_assets > 33746800000 OR executive_profiles != 'Christine Oldridge' OR company_name = 'Rectifier Technologies Ltd';
